gloss: secret talk; confidential conversation; whispered story

definitions.gloss: secret talk; confidential conversation; whispered story
definitions.explanation: A conversation or story shared in confidence, not meant for others to hear.

examples.japanese: {秘密話|ひみつばなし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have a secret to tell.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{秘密話|ひみつばなし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耳元|みみもと}→耳元：28311_mimimoto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{秘密話|ひみつばなし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦したら→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}かれて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧しまった。
examples.english: When I whispered a secret to my friend, the person next to us overheard.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{秘密|ひみつ}→秘密：02504_himitsu⟧ (secret) and ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧ (talk/story), with ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧ voiced to ばなし through rendaku. This is an informal, everyday word often associated with children whispering secrets or friends sharing confidential gossip.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {秘密話|ひみつばなし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to share a secret; to have a confidential conversation
- {秘密話|ひみつばなし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧: to hear a secret
- {秘密話|ひみつばなし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ばれる→ばれる：06721_bareru⟧: for a secret to get out

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{内緒話|ないしょばなし}→内緒話：21425_naishobanashi⟧: secret talk (very similar; ⟦{内緒|ないしょ}→内緒：03126_naisho⟧ is slightly more colloquial)
- ⟦{秘密|ひみつ}→秘密：02504_himitsu⟧: secret (the noun by itself, without the conversational nuance)
- ⟦{噂話|うわさばなし}→噂話：07734_uwasabanashi⟧: gossip (not necessarily secret)
